configurations.name: Baseline (Manual Extraction)
configurations.evidence: Manual extraction from 2 policies took ~45 min each

configurations.name: + LLM Automation
configurations.evidence: 15 policies extracted in ~3 minutes total = 12s per policy

configurations.name: + RAG (Hybrid Retrieval)
configurations.evidence: RAG adds context retrieval overhead but improves accuracy

configurations.name: + Critic (Validation Gate)
configurations.evidence: Critic validation adds minimal overhead, prevents extraction errors

recommendation: Full stack (LLM + RAG + Critic) for production
